name: SGGX Convolution Approximation
aliases: Convolution of SGGX and Isotropic Distribution
definition: An approximation of the convolution between an SGGX lobe $D_{sggx}(n; R, \alpha)$ and an isotropic spherical distribution $g(\omega; n)$ by another SGGX with increased roughness.
summary: The SGGX Convolution Approximation efficiently models surface roughness by approximating the convolution of an SGGX distribution with an isotropic blur as a roughened SGGX distribution, avoiding complex integrals.
